title: Simulador Oficial Completo TOEIC® - Versión 4
description: Simulador completo real de Listening & Reading enfocado en Nova Solutions y el líder the PR Director.

parts.visual:
## 📝 Simulador Oficial TOEIC® (Versión 4)

Evaluación de **Listening & Reading** en tiempo real:

1. **Listening Section**: Evalúa tu comprensión en Nova Solutions usando QuantumCRM.
2. **Reading Section**: Mide tu análisis gramatical de memorandos emitidos por the PR Director.

*Inicia tu prueba simulada oficial.*
parts.audio: Welcome to the Full TOEIC Simulation. Manage your time efficiently across both listening and reading stages. Let's begin.

questions.question: [PART 1 - PHOTO]: Select the best description of Nova Solutions's office photo.
questions.audio_script: A) They are recording a television commercial. B) They are discussing the brand logo on the display screen. C) They are distributing marketing leaflets. D) The design agency is closed.
questions.explanation: Se observa al equipo de diseño analizando la tipografía y el logotipo de la marca en la pantalla.

questions.question: [PART 3 - CONVERSATION]: Listen to the dialogue and answer: What does the man agree to do next?
questions.audio_script:
M: Hi Amanda, did the PR firm Nova Solutions approve the press release?
W: Yes. The PR Director wants us to coordinate the release of the campaign data through QuantumCRM.
M: Great, let's schedule a conference to finalize this.
options: Sign the contract as currently written.
Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
Write a new memorandum to sales staff.
questions.correct_answer: Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
questions.explanation: El hombre dice: 'I will call their manager to negotiate an extension'.

questions.question:
[PART 5]: Complete the business sentence correctly:

"All employees are strictly required to comply ___ the updated security rules in QuantumCRM."
questions.explanation: El verbo 'comply' rige gramaticalmente la preposición 'with' (comply with / cumplir con).

questions.question:
[PART 7]: Read the memorandum and answer: **When will the migration to QuantumCRM officially occur?**

**MEMORANDUM**

*To:* Marketing Associates
*From:* Public Relations Department
*Subject: Campaign Rollout & QuantumCRM Sync*

Please note that starting next Friday, all digital advertising metrics must be synchronized with QuantumCRM. A alignment session will take place this Thursday at 1:00 PM in Conference Suite 4.
questions.explanation: El memorando dice: 'starting next Thursday, we are officially retiring our legacy sales tool and migrating to QuantumCRM'.
